audience: data scientists and ML engineers who explore text and embedding datasets in Nomic Atlas

useCases.title: Find records that are similar to a given record
useCases.text: The AI takes record ids from a dataset and returns their nearest neighbours in embedding space, with distances.

useCases.title: List the datasets of your organization
useCases.text: The AI finds your organization and the datasets it holds, then opens one to read its schema, size, indices and projections.

useCases.title: Check if an index is built before searching
useCases.text: The AI reads the status of an index-building job. A search on an unbuilt map fails, so you can tell if it is ready.

useCases.title: See which fields a projection offers
useCases.text: The AI reads the field schema of one projection, which shows the columns available on its records.

useCases.title: Review the tags made on a map
useCases.text: The AI lists the tags on a projection and checks whether each tag has finished computing its membership. A tag still building gives partial results.
